title: Block coordinate permutation
statement: Let $s,w$ be natural numbers, and let $\sigma$ and $\tau$ be permutations of $\{0,\ldots,s-1\}$ and $\{0,\ldots,w-1\}$, respectively. Identify the $sw$ coordinates with pairs $(i,j)$, where $i<s$ and $j<w$; the block coordinate permutation sends the coordinate $(i,j)$ to $(\sigma(i),\tau(j))$.
